productSubtitle: Unofficial geometric coverage estimate from public orbit catalogs

tiles.none: No window in the computed span
tiles.nowHintHeld: above the mask at this clock

sentence: At {el}° minimum elevation over {place}, the current catalog produces {n} {windows} today totalling {minutes} minutes. This is geometric line-of-sight from public orbit data, not proof that a terminal can attach, that capacity exists, or that inter-satellite links are on.
sentenceHeld: At {el}° minimum elevation over {place}, the current catalog produces {n} {windows} on {day} totalling {minutes} minutes. This is geometric line-of-sight from the latest public GP at the selected clock, not an archived element set, and not proof that a terminal can attach, that capacity exists, or that inter-satellite links are on.

clock.label: Clock
clock.hint: Set the clock within ±48 hours of real now. The live tick pauses until you return to Live.
clock.bands: Shaded bands are geometric line-of-sight over this point across ±48 hours. Tap a band to hold the clock at acquisition (AOS).
clock.band: Geometric line-of-sight {start}–{end}, {minutes} min. Hold the clock at acquisition.
clock.bandsEmpty: No geometric line-of-sight in this ±48 hour span for this point, mask, and population.
clock.banner: Held at {when} ({offset}). Still geometric line-of-sight from the latest public GP, not an archived element set. Accuracy falls off away from the element epoch; climbing or maneuvering objects can look wrong.
clock.clamped: That time is outside ±48 hours of real now, so it was clamped.

passList.title: Next 36 hours
passList.hint: Per-object geometric passes. Overlapping objects are listed separately; the Today tile unions them into windows. AOS/LOS stepped at 30 s with linear interpolation, labelled ±30 s.
passList.hintHeld: Per-object geometric passes in the 36 hours after the selected clock — not the next 36 hours from wall-clock now. Overlapping objects are listed separately. AOS/LOS stepped at 30 s with linear interpolation, labelled ±30 s.
passList.empty: No geometric passes in the next 36 hours for this point, mask, and population.
passList.emptyHeld: No geometric passes in the 36 hours after this clock for this point, mask, and population.

cityStrip.label: Same mask and population, other cities
cityStrip.hint: Does not follow the location picker. Minutes are today’s union at the selected elevation.
cityStrip.hintHeld: Does not follow the location picker. Minutes are the union on the selected clock’s calendar day at the selected elevation.

constellation.title: Constellation
constellation.caption: Raised is at least 480 km. Climbing is still below 480 km. Each point is a public catalog element set. Objects take weeks to months to climb; a launch is not coverage that week.

method.title: Method
method.lede: This page is the contract. Numbers on the other screens are only as good as the definitions below.

freshness.seed: Live GP fetch failed. Showing the checked-in snapshot from {date}, not a current element set.
freshness.seedStale: Live GP fetch failed. The checked-in snapshot from {date} is older than 72 hours. Positions are still propagated.
freshness.stale: One or more element sets are older than 72 hours. Positions are still propagated, with a stale mark.

altitudeGloss: Raised means at least 480 km. Climbing means still below 480 km.
